svg.title: Four one-stroke shapes with a split-loaded flat brush. Leaf: press the brush down, slide while turning it a little, and lift to a point; the dark green stays on one edge and the light green on the other. Petal: press with the light corner at the flower center, wiggle out and back, lift; the petal is pale at the base and dark at the rim. Swirl: start on the flat of the brush and finish on its edge, so the line gets thinner. Rotate: keep the light corner still and turn the brush around it for a whole flower in one movement.
svg.text: Rotate: a flower in one turn
